bio.name: Aditya Vahlevy Nugraha
bio.degree_detail: Computer Science graduate from Universitas Pertamina (Cum Laude, GPA 3.58)
bio.current_role_detail: Software Engineer at PT Pupuk Indonesia (Persero)
paragraphs: I build three internal platforms at Pupuk Indonesia. PINTER lets business teams build Google ADK agents on a visual canvas, connect MCP tools, and chat through a smart router that sends each message to a model that fits it. AeGIS Atlas is a fertilizer demand planning map where numbers update as planners change their assumptions. NEXUS moves carrier contracts, freight tariffs, and route costs out of spreadsheets.

I work across the stack: FastAPI and Go services on PostgreSQL and Neo4j, React 19 frontends, and the tests that keep the business logic honest. Before this I predicted rice yield from Sentinel-2 imagery with LightGBM and Optuna, and digitized a rejection tracking workflow at Astra Otoparts.
Beyond the screen, I'm an APERTI BUMN Scholarship awardee, a former Vice President of my student association, and someone who probably thinks about system design way too much at 2am.

thanks.intro: Most of what I know about building software for real users, I learned from people who took the time to show me.
